# Loss offset, grouping and amalgamation for M#ori authorities ¶24-321

Corporate M#ori authorities are included in the scope of the definition of a "company". This means that, subject to the M#ori authority rules, corporate M#ori authorities can apply the tax rules relating to companies.

However, there are limits on the extent to which corporate M#ori authorities can apply the company tax provisions. A M#ori authority may offset net income or tax losses only against the tax losses or net income, as the case may be, of another M#ori authority. Corporate M#ori authorities may amalgamate or form a consolidated group only with other companies that are M#ori authorities. Intercompany distributions between wholly-owned M#ori authorities qualify for the inter-corporate dividend exemption in s CW 10. A company that becomes a M#ori authority ceases to be an ICA company.

*Refs: s CW 10*

Law: IT07 ss CD 37, HF 3, OB 1(2)(b)

*Refs: ss CD 37*
